Tatamagouche Train Station
top of page
BOUTIQUE INN, RESTAURANT
GIFT SHOP & CAFE
"Life was always an adventure growing up with a train station in my backyard. I remember I was just 5 years old when the railway took the Jitney train out of service...I was standing on the platform looking up at Mr. Penny the Stationmaster and I asked "since you don't need the Jitney anymore, can I buy it?" He laughed, patted me on the head and said,"No Jimmie, it's gone somewhere else now."
Jimmie LeFresne
A childhood
...dream
All aboard!
TRAIN STATION INN
Our unique accommodations are vintage Canadian-built cabooses & boxcars, authentic on the outside, redesigned and developed into private deluxe suites on the inside with reflections of their railway past throughout. We also maintain a vast and eclectic gift shop, as well as a locally roasted coffee bar & cafe in our original 19th-century train station, built circa 1887. Our guests can also enjoy local craft beers & ciders from our Baggage Room Bar and live music nights on our railway platform. During your visit, our 600 foot & 400-ton train remains a dominating sight to see within the village of Tatamagouche as you experience our property or stroll along the old rail bed (now the Trans Canada Trail) that meanders alongside our not so forgotten railyard.
BOOK A ROOM
THINGS TO DO
THINGS TO DO
Tatamagouche has lots of places to visit from cafes & bakeries, gift & antique shops, galleries, specialty stores and your mainstay facilities such as a pharmacy & grocery stores etc. not to mention walking & cycling trails with bike rentals , museums & tours, markets and microbreweries. The village also has an arts centre directly next door to the train station with events & performances on a regular basis throughout the summer. The station also hosts live music on the platform 2 or 3 nights a week during the summer.
The Great Trail
Our section of the Trans Canada Trail strolls directly from the station along Tatamagouche Bay past the Creamery Square, Patterson Wharf Park over Campbell's train bridge and onto Nelson Park.
... more
Tata Brew Co.
​
A family-owned and operated microbrewery in the heart of Tatamagouche. Grab some merch, have a drink and relax on the patio.
... more
Creamery Square
​
Famous for our Saturday morning Farmer's Market as well as our state-of-the-art Heritage Centre & Performance Arts Centre.
... more
Appleton Chocolates
​
Very fine hand-dipped chocolates featuring the traditional sweet flavours of the Maritimes (and of Nova Scotia, in particular)- wild blueberries, cranberries, cherries and maple syrup.
... more
Tatamagouche Road Train​
​
The cutest little train ever gives visitors a sightseeing tour around the village of Tata and along the Trans Canada Trail.
... more
Dexter's Butcher Block
​
A very unique butcher shop on Main St. Tata. Naturally aged beef, pork and chicken, sausages, smokehouse and deli meats. "
Where customer service is a cut above the rest."
... more
RAILWAY DINING CAR
At the Tatamagouche Train Station, our philosophy is Fresh is Best, which is why we started our very own garden. We invite you to browse our selection of vegetables and edible flowers, grown without the use of pesticides. After touring the gardens stop for a bite to eat at our Railway Dining Car or Jitney Cafe to see how we put our treasures to use.
VIEW MENU
POLICIES
OUR POLICIES
Rates
All base rates listed are for Sunday - Thursday.
There is an additional charge on all rooms for weekend rates.
We do not accept group bookings of 4 or more rooms.
Restrictions
​
We do not allow pets in our accommodations.
We do not allow smoking/vaping in our accommodations.
If we detect smoking/vaping or pets in your room an additional full night's rate will be applied to your credit card on file.
Check-In
​
Check-in is anytime after 3PM. We do not have an early check-in process.
If you are a late arrival we have a late self-check-in process that is described in your email confirmation.
Cancellation
​
Guests must cancel by 3:00 PM (inn time) a minimum of 48 hours before arrival to avoid the penalty of the full cost of the first night's room or rooms and tax. Weather, illness and government lockdowns do not negate our policy. A charge will be applied to the card on file for any reservation cancelled within 48 hours of arrival.
​
A $12 holding fee will be applied to the card on file per held room any time a reservation is cancelled prior to our 48 hour cancellation policy. There is no fee if you wish to change your reservation to another date. Changing dates within 48 hours of arrival of the original reservation would fall under our 48-hour cancellation policy.
​
We recommend adequate travel insurance in case of a need to cancel.

Rooms | Train Station Inn & Railway Dining Car | Tatamagouche
top of page
​ ​
*All base rates listed are for Sunday - Thursday. There is an additional charge on all rooms for weekend rates (Friday & Saturday).
*Effective October 2nd, 2023 there will be an additional 3% tax applied to all rates. This by-law was brought in by the Municipality of Colchester under " C hapter 19 Marketing Levy By-Law" .
​
​
*We provide free Wi-Fi access throughout our property for our visitors with secured and unsecured access points in our lounge car and caf however we cannot guarantee Wi-Fi will be available/consistent inside the overnight accommodations.
​
ROOMS
CABOOSE #4
​
*Max occupancy: 4 ppl
It's the orange one directly behind the train station. Coupled between boxcar "Jimmie" and the dining car, this caboose has a queen bed as well as two singles in the form of a bunk bed...so your kids can fight over the top bunk. Don't forget, all of our railway cars have a private washroom, this one even has a bathtub.
*This unit is best for 2 adults & 2 children.
Starting at:
239.00
Book Now
CABOOSE #5
*Max occupancy: 2 ppl
This one's an oldie, 1912 to be exact. Great for 2 people that just want to get away. A queen bed on the main level with a look out that makes a great reading nook in the cupola. All of our rooms have private washrooms, like caboose #4 this one has a bathtub.

229.00
